evaluation_design.task: extract width_cm, height_cm, color, lace, and pieces from Japanese product descriptions
evaluation_design.schema_comparison: same English field names with Japanese versus English semantic descriptions

ja.width_cm: 選択されたSKUの幅寸法。幅×丈の2値表記は最初の値だけを対象にし、シリーズ全体のサイズ候補を列挙した説明から選択外の幅を拾わない。
ja.height_cm: 選択されたSKUの丈または高さ寸法。幅×丈の2値表記は2番目の値だけを対象にし、シリーズ全体のサイズ候補を列挙した説明から選択外の丈を拾わない。
ja.color: 商品の色名、色柄の名前。色違いを区別する原文の範囲を抽出する。
ja.lace: この選択SKUにレースカーテンが含まれるかの明示的な選択肢。あり・なし、付属・非付属などの状態語だけを抽出する。レースカーテンという商品種類名だけから有無を推定しない。
ja.pieces: 商品に含まれる枚数、個数、組数、セット数。数量を示す原文の範囲を抽出する。

en.width_cm: The width dimension of the selected SKU. For a width-by-drop pair, use only the first component. Do not extract other size choices listed for the wider product series.
en.height_cm: The curtain drop or height dimension of the selected SKU. For a width-by-drop pair, use only the second component. Do not extract other size choices listed for the wider product series.
en.color: A product color or color-pattern name. Extract the exact source span that distinguishes color variants.
en.lace: An explicit selected-SKU option stating whether a lace curtain is included or not included. Extract an inclusion or exclusion status only. Never infer inclusion from a product type such as lace curtain or sheer curtain.
en.pieces: The number of pieces, panels, items, or sets included in the product. Extract the exact source span that gives the quantity.

suitability_assessment.candidate_use: standalone attribute extraction candidate, distinct from the Decide pairwise classifier
open_questions: Japanese product attribute precision and recall are unmeasured.
CPU throughput and peak RSS have not yet been measured for this extraction task.
The encoder config declares dtype float16, while both the HF API and verified safetensors header report F32 stored weights.
